_meta.purpose: THE ROCK TIER. Element -> Compound (mineral) -> ROCK. A rock is a MODAL MIXTURE of minerals, NOT a stoichiometric compound - which is exactly why Book III defines Granite as 'Coarse-grained Igneous Rock' with no formula. It has none. It never did.
_meta.minerals: MOVED (Unification Ruling R6b, 2026-07-13, docs/prism-book-updates-worldgen.md A7): minerals ARE compounds - ONE registry. The 12 sim-required minerals (olivine..serpentine) are first-class compound entries, category 'mineral', ids 79-90; since 2026-08-19 they live in crust_compounds.json (the mantle/world-formation-sim half of the compound catalog, split out of compounds.json). This file defines no minerals.
_meta.modal_scheme: Each rock's `modal` map is keyed by the EXACT compound `name` from the compound catalog (compounds.json + crust_compounds.json — e.g. 'Olivine' from the crust file, 'Quartz'/'Clay' from the gameplay file), resolved through the flicker-materials Tables compound-by-name index at load; values are modal fractions summing to 1. Names, not numeric ids, so the recipes stay hand-readable; a key that fails to resolve is a content error.
_meta.derived_not_stored: A Layer stores MINERALS (conserved). rock_kind(layer) is a PURE CLASSIFIER over the modal assay, recomputed, never stored - the same rule as crust_kind. No third conserved ledger.
_meta.hardness: hardness(layer) = modal-weighted erosional_resistance. THIS IS WHAT THE OUTCROP MODEL QUERIES. Without it, differential erosion cannot happen and every mountain comes out smooth.
_meta.resistance_scale: 0 = strips instantly (evaporite) .. 1 = stands as a ridge forever (quartzite). NOT Mohs - Mohs is scratch hardness; this is resistance to weathering + fluvial incision. Limestone is Mohs 3 but DISSOLVES; quartzite is Mohs 7 and endures.
_meta.book_status: GRANTED. Book III carried no igneous or mantle minerals and no Mg or Li ore; Unification Ruling R6/R6b (2026-07-13) adopted the mineral/rock tier as committed canon. sim_required marks what the sim added beyond the Book III crafting tables. Harvestable flags were NOT extended (spodumene/dolomite ore notes await a separate ruling).
